title: [UE-0.12] Eval camera switch
body:

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] `-EvalCam=CAM_Eval_Arena` (any CameraActor name) on a Development package views from that camera, runs `HighResShot 1920x1080`, logs `EVALCAM_OK cam=CAM_Eval_Arena file=PATH` and exits 0
- [ ] A camera name that is not in the map logs an Error naming it and the run exits 1 (pasted)
- [ ] The switch is compiled only when `!UE_BUILD_SHIPPING` (`pipeline/unreal-rules.md`, eval cameras)

### Budget and cut tier

60 min agent + 15 min human, MVP
